Great Cardiac vein: It accompanies first the anterior interventricular artery (in anterior atrioventricular groove) and then the circumflex artery (in left anterior atrioventricular groove).
It receives the left marginal vein from the left ventricle.
Branches.Middle Cardiac vein: It accompanies the posterior interventricular artery (in posterior interventricular groove), and joins the middle part of the coronary sinus.
Branches.Small Cardiac vein: It accompanies the right coronary artery in right posterior coronary sulcus and joins the right end of the coronary sinus.
Oblique vein of left atrium: It is a small vein running on the posterior surface of the left atrium.
Branches.Posterior vein of left ventricle: It runs on the diaphragmatic surface of left ventricle.

Venae Cordis Minimae: It is also called as Thebesian vein.
